description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 07.09.2015 to 13.09.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically determining how customs valuations and payments should be calculated using specified currency exchange rates. The content involves legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure, land, commercial, elections, public service, judicial, or other specialized categories, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
